name: Screen/Standalone — Modules (East selected)
context: PR #630 remote workload catalog for the selected east registration. The category strip scrolls horizontally. Source management requires modules:manage on the selected cluster. Changing cluster discards open upload, builder, install and source drafts; mutation actions retain their captured cluster target.

VbHwU.content: Pre-packaged game-server templates pulled from your configured module sources.

children.content: Vanilla / Paper / Spigot / Bukkit / Purpur / Forge / NeoForge / Fabric / Quilt servers with a version+loader picker and in-app Modrinth browse.
Cross-platform edition for mobile, console and Windows clients. Allow-list and permissions managed from the wizard.
Valheim dedicated server (lloesche/valheim-server) with a stable/public-test channel picker, a BepInEx mod volume, and in-app Thunderstore browse. Crossplay-friendly.
Factorio headless server (factoriotools/factorio) with a stable/latest/pinned channel picker, server-settings managed from the wizard, and a mods volume with in-app Factorio mod portal browse.
Palworld dedicated server (thijsvanloef/palworld-server-docker) with RCON console, save-aware graceful stop, and a .pak mod volume with archive install.
Dinosaur survival on the Unreal engine. Mod install via the Steam workshop; schedule onto a GPU node for acceptable tick rates.
Terraria + tModLoader dedicated server (passivelemon/terraria-docker) with a vanilla/tModLoader version picker and a tModLoader ModPacks volume. Console via container stdin.
Competitive shooter with MatchZy and CounterStrikeSharp plugin support. Game-server login token supplied as a secret.
Hardcore multiplayer survival with Oxide and Carbon mod loaders. Monthly forced wipe; schedule a backup before each one.
Zombie survival crafting in a destructible voxel world. Blood-moon horde nights are CPU-spiky — give it headroom.
Satisfactory dedicated server (wolveix/satisfactory-server) with a stable/experimental branch picker. Env-configured; installs via steamcmd on first boot.
